name: French Toast
desc: Thick bread soaked in a flour-thickened cinnamon vanilla custard and griddled golden.

source.title: Fluffy French Toast
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (1/4 cup flour, 1 cup milk, 3 eggs, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tbsp sugar, pinch of salt, 12 thick slices), read through a Punchfork copy because allrecipes.com blocked direct reads.

ingredients.raw: 12 thick (3/4-inch) slices bread, such as Texas toast, brioche, or challah
ingredients.prep: such as Texas toast, brioche, or challah

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp unsalted butter, for the griddle

steps: Put the flour in a large bowl and slowly whisk in the milk until smooth. Whisk in the salt, eggs, cinnamon, vanilla, and sugar until smooth. Pour into a shallow dish.
Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium heat and grease it lightly with butter.
Soak each slice of bread until saturated but not falling apart, 5 to 10 seconds per side (up to 30 seconds for dry, thick challah or brioche).
Cook until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side, adding butter to the griddle as needed. Serve hot.
tips: Keep finished slices warm on a baking sheet in a 275°F oven while you cook the rest.

references.title: French Toast
references.usedFor: 5 to 10 second soak, 3 to 4 minutes per side
